sup_meta_description: Get help with DailyCumulus: contact us, manage your subscription, restore purchases, request a refund, or delete your account.
sup_lede: Questions, bugs, or ideas? Email us.
sup_q_cancel: How do I cancel my subscription?
sup_a_cancel: Subscriptions are managed by Apple or Google. iPhone: Settings › your name › Subscriptions › DailyCumulus. Android: Google Play Store › your profile › Payments & subscriptions › Subscriptions. Deleting the app or your account doesn't cancel it.
sup_q_restore: I got a new phone. How do I get Premium back?
sup_a_restore: Install DailyCumulus, sign in with the same account, then open Premium and tap Restore purchases. Use the same Apple ID or Google account you paid with.
sup_a_refund: Payments go through the App Store or Google Play, so refunds are handled there: Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com, Google from your Google Play order history. If you were charged twice or something went wrong on our side, email us. Details are in our Terms.
sup_q_delete: How do I delete my account?
sup_a_delete: In the app, go to Profile › Settings › Delete account. You can also request deletion here.
sup_a_privacy: On the free plan, your entries are stored only on your phone. You can save a backup file anytime in Profile › Settings › Your data. With Premium, they're also backed up to the cloud. For details, see our Privacy Policy.
sup_crisis: DailyCumulus is a mood journal, not a medical or mental health service, and it can't respond in an emergency. If you're in immediate danger, call 911. To reach the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, call or text 988. If you're outside the US, call your local emergency number.
notes_meta_description: See what's new in each DailyCumulus update for iPhone and Android.
notes_lede: What's changed in each update. iPhone and Android updates sometimes come out on different days.

notes_entries.title: Photos in backups
items: Photos in backups Backups now include your photos. Tap Save a backup in Settings › Your data to get everything in one file, free for everyone. Older CSV backups can still be restored.
Fixed feelings and activities you made before signing in showing a code instead of their name.
The What's new screen no longer pops up for people who just installed the app.
Improved stability when you unlock the app with App lock.

notes_entries.title: Widgets, Mongle Insights, and rest days
items: Widgets See today's mood and your streak right on your Home Screen, and tap to check in. On iPhone, you can add one to your Lock Screen too.
Mongle Insights Mongle spots patterns in your entries and sums them up for you. You get one insight a month for free, and Premium shows them all. All the stats you already had are still free.

Rest days Earn one for every 7 days you check in. The days don't have to be in a row. If you miss a day, one is used automatically so your streak keeps going. You can hold up to 2, or up to 4 with Premium. Premium also gives you an extra one every Monday.
Backup and restore Save your entries to a CSV file and restore them anytime, for free. You'll find it in Profile › Settings › Your data. Photos aren't included in the file.
Your own feelings and activities Add up to 5 of your own for free (feelings and activities combined), or as many as you like with Premium.
Longer notes Notes can now be up to 5,000 characters.
On this day Look back at what you logged on this date in past years.
Share my month Turn your monthly flower into a picture you can share. With Premium, you can also save it as a PDF. Your notes and photos aren't on it.
New themes Night garden, Lilac dusk, Sage, Morning sky, and Cherry blossom come with Premium. Classic is free.
7-day free trial New subscribers can try Premium Yearly free for 7 days. If you have notifications on, we'll send a reminder the day before your trial ends.
